### The Day Abraham Planted a Tree
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/the-day-abraham-planted-a-tree/
Passage: Genesis 21:33
Points:
- Planting a tamarisk tree at Beersheba was an act of claiming the land God had promised.
- Abraham called on the everlasting God to publicly declare and celebrate God's covenant faithfulness.
- Standing in the land with Isaac pointed ahead to the ultimate fulfillment found in Christ.
- Modern Christians gather each week as heirs of the world who celebrate the same faithful God.
- God gives His pilgrim people peace so they can boldly worship Him in an alien world.

### Abimelech and Abraham
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abimelech-and-abraham
Passage: Genesis 21:22-34
Points:
- Abimelech recognized God's blessing on Abraham and sought a binding peace treaty.
- Securing ownership of the well gave Abraham his first permanent foothold in the promised land.
- The treaty demonstrated to Israel that God's people may make peace with others when appropriate.
- Believers are called to be active peacemakers, especially within the church community.
- Forgiveness and repentance are essential to preserving harmony among God's covenant people.
